toegepas.voor: 'n sorgsentrum vir mense met MIV in Johannesburg
toegepas.na: 'n sorgsentrum in Johannesburg vir mense met MIV
toegepas.rede_vinder: Placing 'in Johannesburg' after 'MIV' makes it read as if the virus is in Johannesburg; the place belongs with the centre.
toegepas.fout: 'in Johannesburg' at the end attaches loosely to 'mense met MIV' rather than to the centre.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Moving the place next to 'sorgsentrum' makes clear where the centre was, with the same people and the same facts.

toegepas.na: Sy eie ma is in 1997 oorlede
toegepas.rede_vinder: Right after Gail becomes his 'pleegma', a bare 'Sy ma' could be read as Gail; 'eie' makes clear it is his birth mother.
toegepas.fout: Straight after Gail becomes his 'pleegma', a bare 'Sy ma' can be read by a young reader as Gail.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Sy eie ma' fixes the reference to the birth mother without adding any fact or touching the protected sentence.

toegepas.voor: dat hy nie by hulle mag kom nie
toegepas.na: dat hy nie daar mag skoolgaan nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'hulle' does not agree with the singular 'die skool', and 'by hulle kom' is vague about what was refused.
toegepas.fout: 'nie by hulle mag kom nie' is vague about what was refused.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'nie daar mag skoolgaan nie' says exactly what the school refused, which is the same refusal the lesson describes.

toegepas.rede_vinder: A story spreads ('versprei') through a country; 'geloop' is unidiomatic here.
toegepas.fout: 'Die storie het deur die hele land geloop' is a loose, slightly unidiomatic verb for news spreading.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'versprei' is the natural, exact verb for a story spreading through the country, and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: was daar 'n groot vergadering oor MIV en vigs in Durban
toegepas.na: was daar in Durban 'n groot vergadering oor MIV en vigs
toegepas.rede_vinder: With 'in Durban' at the end it attaches to 'vigs'; moving the place forward makes it belong to the meeting.
toegepas.fout: With 'in Durban' at the end it reads as attached to 'vigs' rather than to the meeting.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Placing 'in Durban' after 'daar' is the natural Afrikaans word order and ties the place to the meeting, with MIV and vigs untouched.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: An institution 'het gesluit' copies English 'closed'; 'het toegemaak' is the natural Afrikaans for a centre closing down.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Die sentrum het gesluit' is standard Afrikaans for an institution closing down, not an anglicism; 'toegemaak' is only a lateral move.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'weggevat' is colloquial; 'weggeneem' is the standard written form for a right being taken away.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'weggevat' is ordinary, plain Afrikaans suited to a Grade 5 reader; 'weggeneem' is only a register shift.

laat_vaar.na: gesê die skool het reg opgetree
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'die skool is reg' says the school is correct rather than that its action was right; 'het reg opgetree' says what is meant.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'gesê die skool is reg' is natural Afrikaans for taking the school's side and parallels the next sentence; the proposal is longer and only different.

laat_vaar.voor: Hy het in 1997 daar begin en
laat_vaar.na: Hy het in 1997 daar begin skoolgaan en
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'daar begin' has no complement and reads as unfinished; 'begin skoolgaan' completes the verb.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Hy het in 1997 daar begin' is idiomatic Afrikaans for starting at a school, and adding 'skoolgaan' would repeat the word just used in change 4.

vlae.teks: Hy het gevra dat almal dieselfde behandel word.
vlae.rede: Slightly vague (equal treatment of whom, compared with whom), and 'behandel' returns later in its medical sense ('Vandag word MIV ook behandel'), so the 'ook' may read as an echo; not changed because sharpening it would mean guessing what Nkosi asked.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The protected entry says HOU 'VIGS' in capitals, but the lesson and the decided glossary headword and definition use lowercase 'vigs' (the AWS form). Nothing was changed; a person may want the entry and the lesson to agree on the case.
